claims.text: The former AARO director is a senior technology executive at the national laboratory that performed both of AARO's published specimen analyses, including the January 2026 aluminium analysis. Reasoning: his ORNL role dates from December 2023 and the ORNL/AARO aluminium supplement is dated January 2026.
